card.name: Linking words in standard section headings
card.fires_on: Small linking words or the next word inside fixed label section titles, such as 'Use in Specific Populations', 'Effects on Ability to Drive' and 'Impairment of Fertility'. It fires on the word after the title's first noun.

modes.label: Use in Specific Populations
modes.description: The word 'in' inside the cross-reference title 'Use in Specific Populations'.

modes.label: Driving and fertility headings
modes.description: A word partway through headings like 'Effects on Ability to Drive' or 'Impairment of Fertility'.
modes.example: Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment<< of>> Fertility Carcinogenesis

modes.label: Other fixed headings
modes.description: A word partway through other multi-word headings, such as activities requiring mental alertness or women who may become pregnant.
modes.example: Activities Re<<quiring>> Mental Alertness Patients should be warned about

card.writes: It seems to push the next word of a familiar heading, such as 'Specific' or 'to', though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the middle words of standard label section titles, such as 'Use in Specific Populations'.
